issue.title: Machine-scope server sends a 127.0.0.1 contentBase over the Cloud relay, so boards fail on other machines
issue.body:
- [x] I searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate

@Innei This is a second code path behind the symptom in #14. #14 is closed, so I am filing it separately. The root-cause comment there: https://github.com/Innei/ryugi/issues/14#issuecomment-6751476353

## Who's filing this report? (required)

An AI coding agent (Claude Code), filing for my human partner. Their words (translated from Chinese): "Ryugi still doesn't work, it reproduces the same way." After a local one-line patch: "It works." Then: "Open a new issue or mention the author."

## Human-authored summary (required, under 200 words)

From the human partner, translated from Chinese:

> After the #14 fix, opening a Cloud link on another computer still shows "127.0.0.1 refused to connect" on every board while the artifacts server runs on the dev machine. With the one-line patch below, it works.

## Environment (required)

| Field                               | Value |
| ----------------------------------- | ----- |
| Ryugi version                       | `ryugi-artifacts` 1.70.1 (server), Cloud viewer 1.70.1 |
| Harness (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) | Claude Code |
| Harness version                     | 2.1.317 |
| Your model + version                | Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) |
| All plugins installed               | None. The CLI runs through `npx -y ryugi-artifacts@latest` |
| OS + shell                          | Server: Linux aarch64, bash. Viewer: a browser on a second computer |

## Is this a Ryugi issue or a platform issue?

- [ ] I confirmed this issue does not occur without Ryugi installed

How I verified that this issue does not reproduce without Ryugi: not applicable. The bug is in the `ryugi-artifacts` server and the Cloud viewer.

## What happened?

The machine-scope server answers Cloud relay `meta` requests with a loopback `contentBase`. The viewer uses it, so every board iframe on another machine loads `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/c/...`.

## Steps to reproduce

1. On machine A, sign in and run `npx -y ryugi-artifacts@latest start --no-open --project-dir <project> --artifact artboard/<id>`. Leave the server running.
2. On machine B, open the artifact's `https://ryugi.innei.dev/a/<id>` link and refresh.
3. Wait a few seconds after the snapshot appears.

## Expected behavior

The boards stay visible and show live content through the Cloud relay.

## Actual behavior

The boards switch to "127.0.0.1 refused to connect".

## Cause (`dist/server.cjs`)

`start` runs the machine-scope server, and each project is a mount. The mount's exported `handleRelay` binds the loopback origin:

```js
handleRelay: (key2, body, conn) => handleRelay(ctx, key2, body, conn, `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`),
```

The machine server's Cloud relay client is the only caller of that export:

```js
handle: async (composite, body, conn) => {
  const { project, key: key2 } = split(composite);
  return (await mountOf(project)).handleRelay(key2, body, conn);
},
```

`artifactMeta` then returns `contentBase: \`${contentOrigin}${contentPrefix}${ref.type}/${ref.id}/\``. In `live` mode the viewer (`CloudLayout-*.js`) uses any `contentBase` that matches `/^https?:\/\//` and falls back to `liveContentBase` only for a relative value. The #14 fix (hidden layer plus ready and painted messages) covers the direct `embed` path only.

The mount's own `createDirectRelay` already passes the loopback origin for direct connections. The project-scope relay client calls `handleRelay(ctx, key2, body, conn)` without an origin, which is correct.

## Fix verified locally

```js
handleRelay: (key2, body, conn) => handleRelay(ctx, key2, body, conn),
```

With this one-line change and a server restart, machine B shows the boards with live content while the server runs on machine A.

Suggestions:

- Server: the change above, plus a test that a Cloud relay `meta` from the machine-scope server never returns a loopback `contentBase`.
- Viewer (defense in depth): accept a loopback `contentBase` only in direct mode, and use `liveContentBase` in relay mode.

## Debug log or conversation transcript

Machine B, with `localStorage['ryugi:live-log']` set, `__ryugiLiveLog` shows this sequence. Direct attempts to `ws://127.0.0.1:27319`, `27320` and `27321` fail. The viewer opens the Cloud relay, gets `presence online: true, hosts: 1`, and the view goes to `mode: 'live'`. The board iframes then load `http://127.0.0.1:27319/c/...`.

issue.title: ♻️ refactor(styles): migrate ChatInput action bar, editor and mobile to StyleX
issue.body:
<!-- stylex-resolve-stack:start -->
## 当前冲突修复与样式验证 · 2026-11-02

上游：[#22041](https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/pull/22041)。已普通快进推送 `f0a8fd0ce5202864e5c6f8c81dceabaafb7978a3`，无强推；未合并 PR。

本轮范围：本轮处理冲突/静态检查；未新增组件运行证据。

保留最新冻结 canary 的行为并解决样式迁移冲突。

CSS Module 文件及运行时导入均为 0。验证器数据边界、固定图标资源等已提交到 #22041；本地验证器测试不进常规 CI，未提交 Docs。报告仍为 `gateEligible=false`，局部样本不等于整 PR PASS；未执行项不算通过。数据库 CI 不计为样式差异。

汇总与堆叠表见 #22041。下方说明是历史记录，旧 head / 旧阻塞不代表当前状态。
<!-- stylex-resolve-stack:end -->

## What

Moves 37 files from emotion (`createStaticStyles`/`createStyles`) to StyleX and prunes them from `scripts/stylexMigration/legacyFiles.json`. Generated with `bun run stylex:migration --codemod`, remaining files migrated by hand, whole files at a time.

Stacked on `refactor/stylex-foundation` (the `sx()` typing fix), or on the parent batch named in the notes below. After that PR merges, retarget this one to `canary`; if `legacyFiles.json` conflicts, take canary's version and run `bun run stylex:migration --prune-legacy`.

## Notes for the reviewer

ChatInput action bar, editor, mobile (37 files). 7 CSS modules for third-party/`ant-*` selectors; `ActionDropdown` moved from `createGlobalStyle` to `ActionDropdown.global.css` (rules now persist app-wide once the module loads instead of only while mounted); styles split out of the 2200-line `Tools/useControls.tsx` into `useControls.styles.ts`.

Review focus: `!important` dropped in ChatInputNotice, ContextItem image, mobile FilePreview image, AgentMode, Dictation; Desktop `inputFullscreen` uses four longhand radii instead of `border-radius: 0 !important`; `SKILL_*` and `TAG_MARGIN_INLINE_END` constants are duplicated into style files (keep in sync). Last edit (marker fix in `Params/Controls.tsx`) was not re-type-checked by the agent.
Visual check: ActionBar popovers, Dictation states, VoiceMessage send expand animation, composer fullscreen desktop/mobile, mention chips / ActionTag selected.

## Verification

- `bun run check --lint --test` on the changed files and `tsgo --noEmit -p tsconfig.type-check.json`: clean (see the commit messages for the exact runs).
- Browser check on the merged branches (all migration PRs together, local dev server + seeded data, headless Chromium): 61 pages compared against the pre-migration build with computed styles, element boxes and screenshots (light), 16 pages in dark mode, and 322 hover states on 12 pages. The differences it found are fixed in these PRs (see the notes above). Pages that differ only by load timing were re-captured until they matched.
- **Not covered by that check:** popovers, modals and dropdown menus opened by clicks, mobile and narrow-width layouts, pages that need data the seeded account does not have, and Electron-only surfaces. The "Visual check" lists above are the places still worth a look.
- Acceptance: not run. This is a style-system refactor with no intended behaviour change.

comment.body: Superseded by #22687, which combines #21448, #21449 and #21452 on top of current canary.

上游：[#22041](https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/pull/22041)。已普通快进推送 `dff5b451807966eef494720b95d92aeb65579c08`，无强推；未合并 PR。

<!-- stylex-resolve-stack:end -->

<!-- stylex-local-ci:start -->
### 本地验证测试与 CI 隔离 · 2026-10-31

- 修复普通 App CI 误收集本地验证器测试的问题；原失败是 CLI 多子进程用例触发默认 5 秒超时。验证器、实验采集及本地类型契约现在只通过显式入口运行：`bun run stylex:verify:test`；浏览器语料仍为 `bun run stylex:verify self-test`。
- 保留原有迁移 codemod 和产品 `sx` 测试，不禁用应用单测、E2E 或 coverage，也不忽略失败。
- Infra 本地工具测试 29 个文件 / 180 项通过；相关普通 App 测试 7 个文件 / 92 项通过。本分支实际测试发现回归 3 项通过；17 个分支合计 51 项发现回归通过。
- 当前 H：`55574f9ceeeefd782fed065e7ae3bed80ae192aa`。本轮相对上一提交只更改六个本地测试、测试配置、脚本入口和说明文件；产品代码 / CSS 未改动。配置已按原 stack 用普通合并提交同步，没有强推、合并 PR 或启用自动合并。
- 下方 39 组件 / 1,398 探针的样式报告仍对应其中记录的冻结版本；本轮没有重新执行浏览器样式比较，也不把单测结果当作新的 UI 放行证据。新的远端 CI 结果以当前 H 的 Actions 为准。
<!-- stylex-local-ci:end -->

## What

Moves 15 files from emotion (`createStaticStyles`/`createStyles`) to StyleX and prunes them from `scripts/stylexMigration/legacyFiles.json`. Generated with `bun run stylex:migration --codemod`, remaining files migrated by hand, whole files at a time.

Stacked on `refactor/stylex-foundation` (the `sx()` typing fix), or on the parent batch named in the notes below. After that PR merges, retarget this one to `canary`; if `legacyFiles.json` conflicts, take canary's version and run `bun run stylex:migration --prune-legacy`.

## Notes for the reviewer

Acceptance workspace/report/run (15 files). Two CSS modules: `EvidenceComparisonCard.module.css` (`img, video`, `!important` kept) and `ReportViewer.module.css` (`summary::-webkit-details-marker`).

Review focus: `& + &` borders now use `siblingBefore(':is(*)')` → `~` (any later sibling), same while siblings are all rows; shared default marker means any marked ancestor triggers hover rules; `CriterionList` overflow vs the caller's emotion `criteriaList` in `CreateGoalContent` now depends on stylesheet order (check the goal criteria list still scrolls).
Visual check: report coding-scope chips, closed/open `<details>`, 767px breakpoint, VisualizationRenderer views, MergeAcceptanceModal states.

## Verification

- `bun run check --lint --test` on the changed files and `tsgo --noEmit -p tsconfig.type-check.json`: clean (see the commit messages for the exact runs).
- Browser check on the merged branches (all migration PRs together, local dev server + seeded data, headless Chromium): 61 pages compared against the pre-migration build with computed styles, element boxes and screenshots (light), 16 pages in dark mode, and 322 hover states on 12 pages. The differences it found are fixed in these PRs (see the notes above). Pages that differ only by load timing were re-captured until they matched.
- **Not covered by that check:** popovers, modals and dropdown menus opened by clicks, mobile and narrow-width layouts, pages that need data the seeded account does not have, and Electron-only surfaces. The "Visual check" lists above are the places still worth a look.
- Acceptance: not run. This is a style-system refactor with no intended behaviour change.

<!-- stylex-verification-stack:start -->
### StyleX 冲突解决与重测 · 2026-10-31

- 基建：#21963；当前直接上游：#21963。已用合并提交同步上游并解决冲突，保留当前业务行为，没有强推。
- 本轮已测：CriterionRow（20 probes）、EvidenceComparisonCard（42 probes）。62 个探针样本一致，确认样式差异 0，A/A 不稳定 0；结论是 EQUAL_IN_SAMPLES，不是整份 PR PASS。
- 冻结 B：`e4eff764f30d91f2ae7f1c818d1ba3f08facf238`；H：`7307dfbf5b2b50d770d37cfa0c140fb467d392d7`；候选 M tree：`65440cb0a82f62d836fa4bf2322a09bb40050b62`。
- 检测器 hash：`bc8436197afd540f127554464091844bc85c33588b9a94ff24d44a33e698e5dd`。采用 `minimumReleaseAgeStrict=true`，禁止 pnpm 自动添加依赖年龄例外，输入漂移校验与离线浏览器隔离保持启用。
- 最终变更范围类型差分无新增诊断；未声称全仓类型检查通过。定向 lint 无 error（已有 warning 保留）；部分关联单测因本地缺少 local-replica 等依赖无法启动，不算通过。
- 样本之外的未挂载规则、复杂条件、字体和组合边界仍见报告，最终门禁仍是 NEEDS_REVIEW / gateEligible=false。

完整源码快照、锁文件、对照数据及哈希在本机 `.records/stylex-verification/resolve-2026-10-31/`，未上传为 GitHub Actions artifact。额外 30 个 adapter 仍仅在本地，#21963 当前提交的是 14 个 adapter。旧失败 / 错误记录未覆盖；旧轮可重建的 node_modules 副本已清理，锁文件和 pnpm store 保留。

本次只推送冲突修复、同步 stack 和更新结果，不执行合并，不开启自动合并。
